fields.why: The ACIP summary's question is RZV efficacy and safety, and it reports VE estimates, but all are cited from trials; the brief says 'only when the article quantifies vaccine epidemiology' without saying whether cited estimates count, so A's null follows the cited-vs-own logic and is defensible. Rule needed: an evidence summary takes the type of the cited estimates its recommendation rests on (or null when none is its own).

brief_issues: vaccine_outcome_type does not say whether VE or safety figures cited (not computed) in an ACIP/GRADE summary count as 'quantifying vaccine epidemiology'.
